mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO drops > 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month during an economic expansion signals a potential slowdown in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 5% during mid-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals inflationary pressures and supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls in the same month.
